selectedModel.axisDefinition: X is the longest model axis; Z is the shortest. These axes do not define a measured present-day attitude.
selectedModel.qualification: Smooth approximation of published numeric dimensions, not a recovered surface mesh. No mapped terrain, albedo or rotation phase is claimed.

alternatives.disposition: Alternative considered in Table 3. The 2.60 case matches the infrared size more closely; no separate dataset is introduced.

selectedModel.assumptions: SAM1 short-axis-mode solution. Semiminor axes are 4.58/2.60 km. The paper does not establish a unique shape, and its projected-area effective radius is not used as a volume-equivalent radius.
